profile_text.body:
monday.com is a publicly traded company headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel, listed on a stock exchange under the ticker MNDY with a CIK of 0001845338. The company describes itself as offering an AI work platform designed for both people and AI agents, positioning the platform as a single environment where human workers and automated agents execute, manage, and operate together to drive business results.

The company's primary AI product, listed as Monday.com AI, is described as a Work OS with AI capabilities covering project automation and cross-functional data. The site emphasizes that its AI agents are given contextual information before acting, and the company describes the underlying infrastructure as enterprise-grade, with built-in data privacy, governance, permissions, and compliance features. The held facts note Israeli data transfer considerations in connection with the product.

The held facts record 216 law-related exposure entries associated with Illinois, though no specific cases or litigation details are provided in the available data. No MCP server presence is recorded for the company.
